commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  listado -e C0_PC_FUT2230 | ac_consolidate_prices.pl -c Pc_MultiSourceFutures_2230 -t 223000 -

fi
